# Data Simulation, Reactive Reset

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# REACTIVE RESET: Simple Inter-Call Interval Model
# ============================================================================
# Based on Greenfield (1994) inhibitory resetting with rebound
#
# Key mechanism:
# - Baseline ICI = T (natural period)
# - When hearing partner call → pacemaker resets
# - Next ICI shortened to: τ = rebound_ratio × T
# - This creates alternation through mutual inhibition + rapid rebound
# ============================================================================

simulate_reactive_reset <- function(
  duration = 100,
  T1 = 1.0,                    # Natural period individual 1
  T2 = 1.0,                   # Natural period individual 2
  rebound_ratio = 0.4,         # KEY PARAMETER: τ/T
  call_duration = 0.2,
  noise_sd = 0.05,
  duration_noise_sd = 0.15
) {
  
  time <- 0
  voc_times_1 <- numeric()
  voc_times_2 <- numeric()
  voc_durations_1 <- numeric()
  voc_durations_2 <- numeric()
  reset_1 <- logical()  # Track which calls involved resets
  reset_2 <- logical()
  
  # Schedule first calls
  next_call_1 <- runif(1, 0, T1)
  next_call_2 <- runif(1, T1*0.3, T1*0.7)  # Start offset
  
  was_reset_1 <- FALSE
  was_reset_2 <- FALSE
  
  while (time < duration) {
    
    if (next_call_1 < next_call_2) {
      # ============ Individual 1 calls ============
      time <- next_call_1
      if (time >= duration) break
      
      voc_times_1 <- c(voc_times_1, time)
      voc_durations_1 <- c(voc_durations_1, call_duration + rnorm(1, 0, duration_noise_sd))
      reset_1 <- c(reset_1, was_reset_1)
      
      # Check if Individual 2 needs to reset
      # They reset if they're "about to call" (within one call duration)
      if ((next_call_2 - time) < call_duration * 1.5) {
        # Individual 2 is RESET!
        # They must wait, then call with shortened ICI (rebound)
        ICI_2 <- rebound_ratio * T2 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
        next_call_2 <- time + call_duration + ICI_2
        was_reset_2 <- TRUE
      } else {
        was_reset_2 <- FALSE
      }
      
      # Individual 1 continues with their period (normal or rebound)
      if (was_reset_1) {
        # This call was after a reset, so use rebound ICI
        ICI_1 <- rebound_ratio * T1 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      } else {
        # Normal ICI
        ICI_1 <- T1 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      }
      next_call_1 <- time + ICI_1
      was_reset_1 <- FALSE  # Reset flag for next iteration
      
    } else {
      # ============ Individual 2 calls ============
      time <- next_call_2
      if (time >= duration) break
      
      voc_times_2 <- c(voc_times_2, time)
      voc_durations_2 <- c(voc_durations_2, call_duration + rnorm(1, 0, duration_noise_sd))
      reset_2 <- c(reset_2, was_reset_2)
      
      # Check if Individual 1 needs to reset
      if ((next_call_1 - time) < call_duration * 1.5) {
        ICI_1 <- rebound_ratio * T1 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
        next_call_1 <- time + call_duration + ICI_1
        was_reset_1 <- TRUE
      } else {
        was_reset_1 <- FALSE
      }
      
      # Individual 2 continues
      if (was_reset_2) {
        ICI_2 <- rebound_ratio * T2 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      } else {
        ICI_2 <- T2 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      }
      next_call_2 <- time + ICI_2
      was_reset_2 <- FALSE
    }
  }
  
  # Reconstruct phases for comparison (approximate)
  # This helps us visualize the "sawtooth" pattern of discrete resets
  dt <- 0.01
  times <- seq(0, duration, dt)
  phases1 <- numeric(length(times))
  phases2 <- numeric(length(times))
  
  # Simple phase reconstruction: linear increase, jump at resets
  voc_idx_1 <- 1
  voc_idx_2 <- 1
  
  for (i in 1:length(times)) {
    t <- times[i]
    
    # Phase 1
    if (voc_idx_1 <= length(voc_times_1) && t >= voc_times_1[voc_idx_1]) {
      phases1[i] <- 0  # Reset at vocalization
      voc_idx_1 <- voc_idx_1 + 1
    } else if (voc_idx_1 > 1) {
      # Linear increase based on last ICI
      time_since_last <- t - voc_times_1[voc_idx_1 - 1]
      period <- if (voc_idx_1 <= length(voc_times_1)) {
        voc_times_1[voc_idx_1] - voc_times_1[voc_idx_1 - 1]
      } else {
        T1
      }
      phases1[i] <- (time_since_last / period) * 2 * pi
    }
    
    # Phase 2
    if (voc_idx_2 <= length(voc_times_2) && t >= voc_times_2[voc_idx_2]) {
      phases2[i] <- 0
      voc_idx_2 <- voc_idx_2 + 1
    } else if (voc_idx_2 > 1) {
      time_since_last <- t - voc_times_2[voc_idx_2 - 1]
      period <- if (voc_idx_2 <= length(voc_times_2)) {
        voc_times_2[voc_idx_2] - voc_times_2[voc_idx_2 - 1]
      } else {
        T2
      }
      phases2[i] <- (time_since_last / period) * 2 * pi
    }
  }
  
  list(
    voc_times_1 = voc_times_1,
    voc_times_2 = voc_times_2,
    voc_durations_1 = voc_durations_1,
    voc_durations_2 = voc_durations_2,
    reset_1 = reset_1,
    reset_2 = reset_2,
    times = times,
    phases1 = phases1,
    phases2 = phases2,
    T1 = T1,
    T2 = T2,
    rebound_ratio = rebound_ratio
  )
}

simulate_reactive_reset_with_prc <- function(
  duration = 100,
  T1 = 1.0,
  T2 = 1.0,
  prc_slope = 0.3,             # NEW: Explicitly model PRC slope (< 1 for alternation)
  call_duration = 0.3,
  noise_sd = 0.05,
  duration_noise_sd = 0.1
) {
  
  time <- 0
  voc_times_1 <- numeric()
  voc_times_2 <- numeric()
  voc_durations_1 <- numeric()
  voc_durations_2 <- numeric()
  reset_1 <- logical()
  reset_2 <- logical()
  
  next_call_1 <- runif(1, 0, T1)
  next_call_2 <- runif(1, T1*0.3, T1*0.7)
  
  was_reset_1 <- FALSE
  was_reset_2 <- FALSE
  stimulus_phase_1 <- 0  # NEW: Track where in cycle reset occurred
  stimulus_phase_2 <- 0
  
  while (time < duration) {
    
    if (next_call_1 < next_call_2) {
      time <- next_call_1
      if (time >= duration) break
      
      voc_times_1 <- c(voc_times_1, time)
      voc_durations_1 <- c(voc_durations_1, call_duration + rnorm(1, 0, duration_noise_sd))
      reset_1 <- c(reset_1, was_reset_1)
      
      # Check if Individual 2 needs to reset
      if ((next_call_2 - time) < call_duration * 1.5) {
        # Calculate where Individual 2 was in their cycle
        time_since_last_2 <- if(length(voc_times_2) > 0) {
          time - tail(voc_times_2, 1)
        } else {
          time - (next_call_2 - T2)
        }
        stimulus_phase_2 <- time_since_last_2 / T2  # 0-1 scale
        
        # Apply PRC: T′ = s•d + T
        # where d is the delay caused by stimulus
        delay <- call_duration  # Must wait for call to end
        
        # Post-inhibitory rebound: the later in the cycle, the faster the rebound
        # This creates the shallow PRC slope
        rebound_factor <- 1 - (1 - prc_slope) * stimulus_phase_2
        ICI_2 <- rebound_factor * T2 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
        
        next_call_2 <- time + delay + ICI_2
        was_reset_2 <- TRUE
      } else {
        was_reset_2 <- FALSE
      }
      
      # Individual 1 continues
      if (was_reset_1) {
        # This was a rebound call - use adjusted ICI
        rebound_factor <- 1 - (1 - prc_slope) * stimulus_phase_1
        ICI_1 <- rebound_factor * T1 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      } else {
        ICI_1 <- T1 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      }
      next_call_1 <- time + ICI_1
      was_reset_1 <- FALSE
      
    } else {
      # Individual 2 calls (symmetric logic)
      time <- next_call_2
      if (time >= duration) break
      
      voc_times_2 <- c(voc_times_2, time)
      voc_durations_2 <- c(voc_durations_2, call_duration + rnorm(1, 0, duration_noise_sd))
      reset_2 <- c(reset_2, was_reset_2)
      
      if ((next_call_1 - time) < call_duration * 1.5) {
        time_since_last_1 <- if(length(voc_times_1) > 0) {
          time - tail(voc_times_1, 1)
        } else {
          time - (next_call_1 - T1)
        }
        stimulus_phase_1 <- time_since_last_1 / T1
        
        delay <- call_duration
        rebound_factor <- 1 - (1 - prc_slope) * stimulus_phase_1
        ICI_1 <- rebound_factor * T1 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
        
        next_call_1 <- time + delay + ICI_1
        was_reset_1 <- TRUE
      } else {
        was_reset_1 <- FALSE
      }
      
      if (was_reset_2) {
        rebound_factor <- 1 - (1 - prc_slope) * stimulus_phase_2
        ICI_2 <- rebound_factor * T2 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      } else {
        ICI_2 <- T2 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      }
      next_call_2 <- time + ICI_2
      was_reset_2 <- FALSE
    }
  }
  
  # [Keep your phase reconstruction code - it's good!]
  dt <- 0.01
  times <- seq(0, duration, dt)
  phases1 <- numeric(length(times))
  phases2 <- numeric(length(times))
  
  voc_idx_1 <- 1
  voc_idx_2 <- 1
  
  for (i in 1:length(times)) {
    t <- times[i]
    
    if (voc_idx_1 <= length(voc_times_1) && t >= voc_times_1[voc_idx_1]) {
      phases1[i] <- 0
      voc_idx_1 <- voc_idx_1 + 1
    } else if (voc_idx_1 > 1) {
      time_since_last <- t - voc_times_1[voc_idx_1 - 1]
      period <- if (voc_idx_1 <= length(voc_times_1)) {
        voc_times_1[voc_idx_1] - voc_times_1[voc_idx_1 - 1]
      } else {
        T1
      }
      phases1[i] <- (time_since_last / period) * 2 * pi
    }
    
    if (voc_idx_2 <= length(voc_times_2) && t >= voc_times_2[voc_idx_2]) {
      phases2[i] <- 0
      voc_idx_2 <- voc_idx_2 + 1
    } else if (voc_idx_2 > 1) {
      time_since_last <- t - voc_times_2[voc_idx_2 - 1]
      period <- if (voc_idx_2 <= length(voc_times_2)) {
        voc_times_2[voc_idx_2] - voc_times_2[voc_idx_2 - 1]
      } else {
        T2
      }
      phases2[i] <- (time_since_last / period) * 2 * pi
    }
  }
  
  list(
    voc_times_1 = voc_times_1,
    voc_times_2 = voc_times_2,
    voc_durations_1 = voc_durations_1,
    voc_durations_2 = voc_durations_2,
    reset_1 = reset_1,
    reset_2 = reset_2,
    times = times,
    phases1 = phases1,
    phases2 = phases2,
    T1 = T1,
    T2 = T2,
    prc_slope = prc_slope
  )
}



simulate_reactive_reset <- function(
  duration = 100,
  T1 = 1.0,
  T2 = 1.0,
  rebound_ratio = 0.70,  # Higher for clearer bimodality
  call_duration = 0.20,
  noise_sd = 0.05,
  duration_noise_sd = 0.05
) {
  
  time <- 0
  voc_times_1 <- numeric()
  voc_times_2 <- numeric()
  voc_durations_1 <- numeric()
  voc_durations_2 <- numeric()
  
  next_call_1 <- runif(1, 0, T1)
  next_call_2 <- runif(1, T1*0.3, T1*0.7)
  
  was_reset_1 <- FALSE
  was_reset_2 <- FALSE
  
  while (time < duration) {
    
    if (next_call_1 < next_call_2) {
      time <- next_call_1
      if (time >= duration) break
      
      voc_times_1 <- c(voc_times_1, time)
      voc_durations_1 <- c(voc_durations_1, call_duration + rnorm(1, 0, duration_noise_sd))
      
      # Check if Individual 2 needs to reset
      if ((next_call_2 - time) < call_duration * 1.5) {
        # RESET: Next onset will be after call ends + rebound period
        next_call_2 <- time + call_duration + (rebound_ratio * T2) + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
        was_reset_2 <- TRUE
      } else {
        was_reset_2 <- FALSE
      }
      
      # Individual 1 schedules NEXT call
      # The KEY: onset-to-onset should be T (normal) or smaller (if just rebounded)
      if (was_reset_1) {
        # Just rebounded in PREVIOUS cycle, now calling with shortened interval
        next_call_1 <- time + (rebound_ratio * T1) + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      } else {
        # Normal interval
        next_call_1 <- time + T1 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      }
      was_reset_1 <- FALSE
      
    } else {
      time <- next_call_2
      if (time >= duration) break
      
      voc_times_2 <- c(voc_times_2, time)
      voc_durations_2 <- c(voc_durations_2, call_duration + rnorm(1, 0, duration_noise_sd))
      
      if ((next_call_1 - time) < call_duration * 1.5) {
        next_call_1 <- time + call_duration + (rebound_ratio * T1) + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
        was_reset_1 <- TRUE
      } else {
        was_reset_1 <- FALSE
      }
      
      if (was_reset_2) {
        next_call_2 <- time + (rebound_ratio * T2) + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      } else {
        next_call_2 <- time + T2 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      }
      was_reset_2 <- FALSE
    }
  }
  
  # [Your phase reconstruction code stays the same]
  dt <- 0.01
  times <- seq(0, duration, dt)
  phases1 <- numeric(length(times))
  phases2 <- numeric(length(times))
  
  voc_idx_1 <- 1
  voc_idx_2 <- 1
  
  for (i in 1:length(times)) {
    t <- times[i]
    
    if (voc_idx_1 <= length(voc_times_1) && t >= voc_times_1[voc_idx_1]) {
      phases1[i] <- 0
      voc_idx_1 <- voc_idx_1 + 1
    } else if (voc_idx_1 > 1) {
      time_since_last <- t - voc_times_1[voc_idx_1 - 1]
      period <- if (voc_idx_1 <= length(voc_times_1)) {
        voc_times_1[voc_idx_1] - voc_times_1[voc_idx_1 - 1]
      } else {
        T1
      }
      phases1[i] <- (time_since_last / period) * 2 * pi
    }
    
    if (voc_idx_2 <= length(voc_times_2) && t >= voc_times_2[voc_idx_2]) {
      phases2[i] <- 0
      voc_idx_2 <- voc_idx_2 + 1
    } else if (voc_idx_2 > 1) {
      time_since_last <- t - voc_times_2[voc_idx_2 - 1]
      period <- if (voc_idx_2 <= length(voc_times_2)) {
        voc_times_2[voc_idx_2] - voc_times_2[voc_idx_2 - 1]
      } else {
        T2
      }
      phases2[i] <- (time_since_last / period) * 2 * pi
    }
  }
  
  list(
    voc_times_1 = voc_times_1,
    voc_times_2 = voc_times_2,
    voc_durations_1 = voc_durations_1,
    voc_durations_2 = voc_durations_2,
    times = times,
    phases1 = phases1,
    phases2 = phases2,
    T1 = T1,
    T2 = T2,
    rebound_ratio = rebound_ratio
  )
}

simulate_reactive_reset <- function(
  duration = 400,
  T1 = 1.0,
  T2 = 1.0,
  rebound_ratio = 0.45,  # Shorter rebound for tighter alternation
  call_duration = 0.15,
  noise_sd = 0.05,
  duration_noise_sd = 0.05
) {
  
  time <- 0
  voc_times_1 <- numeric()
  voc_times_2 <- numeric()
  voc_durations_1 <- numeric()
  voc_durations_2 <- numeric()
  
  next_call_1 <- runif(1, 0, T1)
  next_call_2 <- runif(1, T1*0.3, T1*0.7)
  
  while (time < duration) {
    
    if (next_call_1 < next_call_2) {
      time <- next_call_1
      if (time >= duration) break
      
      voc_times_1 <- c(voc_times_1, time)
      voc_durations_1 <- c(voc_durations_1, call_duration + rnorm(1, 0, duration_noise_sd))
      
      # Check if Individual 2 needs to reset
      if ((next_call_2 - time) < call_duration * 1.5) {
        # RESET: Individual 2 waits then rebounds
        next_call_2 <- time + call_duration + (rebound_ratio * T2) + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      }
      
      # Individual 1 ALWAYS uses normal period for next call
      # (The rebound happens when they GET reset, not after they call)
      next_call_1 <- time + T1 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      
    } else {
      time <- next_call_2
      if (time >= duration) break
      
      voc_times_2 <- c(voc_times_2, time)
      voc_durations_2 <- c(voc_durations_2, call_duration + rnorm(1, 0, duration_noise_sd))
      
      if ((next_call_1 - time) < call_duration * 1.5) {
        next_call_1 <- time + call_duration + (rebound_ratio * T1) + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      }
      
      next_call_2 <- time + T2 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
    }
  }
  
  # [Phase reconstruction code unchanged]
  dt <- 0.01
  times <- seq(0, duration, dt)
  phases1 <- numeric(length(times))
  phases2 <- numeric(length(times))
  
  voc_idx_1 <- 1
  voc_idx_2 <- 1
  
  for (i in 1:length(times)) {
    t <- times[i]
    
    if (voc_idx_1 <= length(voc_times_1) && t >= voc_times_1[voc_idx_1]) {
      phases1[i] <- 0
      voc_idx_1 <- voc_idx_1 + 1
    } else if (voc_idx_1 > 1) {
      time_since_last <- t - voc_times_1[voc_idx_1 - 1]
      period <- if (voc_idx_1 <= length(voc_times_1)) {
        voc_times_1[voc_idx_1] - voc_times_1[voc_idx_1 - 1]
      } else {
        T1
      }
      phases1[i] <- (time_since_last / period) * 2 * pi
    }
    
    if (voc_idx_2 <= length(voc_times_2) && t >= voc_times_2[voc_idx_2]) {
      phases2[i] <- 0
      voc_idx_2 <- voc_idx_2 + 1
    } else if (voc_idx_2 > 1) {
      time_since_last <- t - voc_times_2[voc_idx_2 - 1]
      period <- if (voc_idx_2 <= length(voc_times_2)) {
        voc_times_2[voc_idx_2] - voc_times_2[voc_idx_2 - 1]
      } else {
        T2
      }
      phases2[i] <- (time_since_last / period) * 2 * pi
    }
  }
  
  list(
    voc_times_1 = voc_times_1,
    voc_times_2 = voc_times_2,
    voc_durations_1 = voc_durations_1,
    voc_durations_2 = voc_durations_2,
    times = times,
    phases1 = phases1,
    phases2 = phases2,
    T1 = T1,
    T2 = T2,
    rebound_ratio = rebound_ratio
  )
}


simulate_reactive_reset_simple <- function(
  duration = 100,
  T1 = 1.0,
  T2 = 1.0,
  rebound_ratio = 0.6,      # After reset, next period is shortened
  inhibit_duration = 0.20,   # Can't call during partner's call
  noise_sd = 0.05,
  duration_noise_sd = 0.05
) {
  
  time <- 0
  voc_times_1 <- numeric()
  voc_times_2 <- numeric()
  voc_durations_1 <- numeric()
  voc_durations_2 <- numeric()
  
  # Track current period (can be T or rebound_ratio*T)
  current_period_1 <- T1
  current_period_2 <- T2
  
  # Track phase (0 to current_period)
  phase_1 <- runif(1, 0, T1)
  phase_2 <- runif(1, 0, T2)
  
  while (time < duration) {
    
    # Time until each individual calls
    time_to_call_1 <- current_period_1 - phase_1
    time_to_call_2 <- current_period_2 - phase_2
    
    if (time_to_call_1 < time_to_call_2) {
      # Individual 1 calls
      time <- time + time_to_call_1
      if (time >= duration) break
      
      voc_times_1 <- c(voc_times_1, time)
      voc_durations_1 <- c(voc_durations_1, inhibit_duration + rnorm(1, 0, duration_noise_sd))
      
      # Individual 1 resets, uses normal period next
      phase_1 <- 0
      current_period_1 <- T1 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      
      # Individual 2 advances, then gets RESET
      phase_2 <- phase_2 + time_to_call_1
      
      # RESET Individual 2: reset phase, use REBOUND period next
      phase_2 <- 0
      current_period_2 <- (rebound_ratio * T2) + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      
    } else {
      # Individual 2 calls
      time <- time + time_to_call_2
      if (time >= duration) break
      
      voc_times_2 <- c(voc_times_2, time)
      voc_durations_2 <- c(voc_durations_2, inhibit_duration + rnorm(1, 0, duration_noise_sd))
      
      phase_2 <- 0
      current_period_2 <- T2 + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
      
      phase_1 <- phase_1 + time_to_call_2
      
      # RESET Individual 1
      phase_1 <- 0
      current_period_1 <- (rebound_ratio * T1) + rnorm(1, 0, noise_sd)
    }
  }
  
  # Phase reconstruction
  dt <- 0.01
  times <- seq(0, duration, dt)
  phases1 <- numeric(length(times))
  phases2 <- numeric(length(times))
  
  voc_idx_1 <- 1
  voc_idx_2 <- 1
  
  for (i in 1:length(times)) {
    t <- times[i]
    
    if (voc_idx_1 <= length(voc_times_1) && t >= voc_times_1[voc_idx_1]) {
      phases1[i] <- 0
      voc_idx_1 <- voc_idx_1 + 1
    } else if (voc_idx_1 > 1) {
      time_since_last <- t - voc_times_1[voc_idx_1 - 1]
      period <- if (voc_idx_1 <= length(voc_times_1)) {
        voc_times_1[voc_idx_1] - voc_times_1[voc_idx_1 - 1]
      } else {
        T1
      }
      phases1[i] <- (time_since_last / period) * 2 * pi
    }
    
    if (voc_idx_2 <= length(voc_times_2) && t >= voc_times_2[voc_idx_2]) {
      phases2[i] <- 0
      voc_idx_2 <- voc_idx_2 + 1
    } else if (voc_idx_2 > 1) {
      time_since_last <- t - voc_times_2[voc_idx_2 - 1]
      period <- if (voc_idx_2 <= length(voc_times_2)) {
        voc_times_2[voc_idx_2] - voc_times_2[voc_idx_2 - 1]
      } else {
        T2
      }
      phases2[i] <- (time_since_last / period) * 2 * pi
    }
  }
  
  list(
    voc_times_1 = voc_times_1,
    voc_times_2 = voc_times_2,
    voc_durations_1 = voc_durations_1,
    voc_durations_2 = voc_durations_2,
    times = times,
    phases1 = phases1,
    phases2 = phases2,
    T1 = T1,
    T2 = T2,
    rebound_ratio = rebound_ratio
  )
}
```

# Data Simulation, Gradual Entrainment

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# PERFECT SYNCHRONY with BIOLOGICAL VARIABILITY
# ============================================================================

simulate_perfect_synchrony_realistic <- function(
  duration = 100,
  freq1_init = 1.0,
  freq2_init = 1.5,
  phase_coupling = -0.06,
  tempo_coupling = 0.10,
  dt = 0.01,
  phase_noise_sd = 0.02,        # Noise in phase dynamics
  freq_noise_sd = 0.001,         # NEW: Noise in frequency adjustments
  ici_noise_sd = 0.05,           # Timing jitter in call production
  duration_vocalisation = 0.25,
  duration_noise_sd = 0.15,      # Variability in call duration
  initial_phase_diff = pi * 0.3
) {
  
  times <- seq(0, duration, dt)
  n_steps <- length(times)
  
  phases1 <- numeric(n_steps)
  phases2 <- numeric(n_steps)
  freqs1 <- numeric(n_steps)
  freqs2 <- numeric(n_steps)
  
  phases1[1] <- 0
  phases2[1] <- initial_phase_diff
  freqs1[1] <- freq1_init
  freqs2[1] <- freq2_init
  
  voc_times_1 <- numeric()
  voc_times_2 <- numeric()
  voc_durations_1 <- numeric()
  voc_durations_2 <- numeric()
  
  for (i in 2:n_steps) {
    # TEMPO ADAPTATION with noise
    freq_diff <- freqs2[i-1] - freqs1[i-1]
    freqs1[i] <- freqs1[i-1] + tempo_coupling * freq_diff + rnorm(1, 0, freq_noise_sd)
    freqs2[i] <- freqs2[i-1] - tempo_coupling * freq_diff + rnorm(1, 0, freq_noise_sd)
    
    # Keep frequencies positive and reasonable
    freqs1[i] <- max(0.5, min(2.0, freqs1[i]))
    freqs2[i] <- max(0.5, min(2.0, freqs2[i]))
    
    # PHASE COUPLING with noise
    phase_diff_12 <- phases2[i-1] - phases1[i-1]
    phase_diff_21 <- phases1[i-1] - phases2[i-1]
    
    dphase1 <- 2*pi*freqs1[i] + phase_coupling * sin(phase_diff_12) + rnorm(1, 0, phase_noise_sd)
    dphase2 <- 2*pi*freqs2[i] + phase_coupling * sin(phase_diff_21) + rnorm(1, 0, phase_noise_sd)
    
    phases1[i] <- phases1[i-1] + dphase1 * dt
    phases2[i] <- phases2[i-1] + dphase2 * dt
    
    
    # Detect vocalizations WITH TIMING JITTER
    if (phases1[i] >= 2*pi && phases1[i-1] < 2*pi) {
      voc_time <- times[i] + rnorm(1, 0, ici_noise_sd)  # Jitter
      voc_times_1 <- c(voc_times_1, voc_time)
      voc_durations_1 <- c(voc_durations_1, rnorm(1, duration_vocalisation, duration_noise_sd))  # Variable duration
      phases1[i] <- phases1[i] %% (2*pi)
    }
    
    if (phases2[i] >= 2*pi && phases2[i-1] < 2*pi) {
      voc_time <- times[i] + rnorm(1, 0, ici_noise_sd)  # Jitter
      voc_times_2 <- c(voc_times_2, voc_time)
      voc_durations_2 <- c(voc_durations_2, rnorm(1, duration_vocalisation, duration_noise_sd))  # Variable duration
      phases2[i] <- phases2[i] %% (2*pi)
    }
    
    phases1[i] <- phases1[i] %% (2*pi)
    phases2[i] <- phases2[i] %% (2*pi)
  }
  
  list(
    times = times,
    phases1 = phases1,
    phases2 = phases2,
    freqs1 = freqs1,
    freqs2 = freqs2,
    voc_times_1 = voc_times_1,
    voc_times_2 = voc_times_2,
    voc_durations_1 = voc_durations_1,
    voc_durations_2 = voc_durations_2
  )
}
```

```{r}

# ============================================================================
# CORRECTED PRC CALCULATION
# ============================================================================

calculate_prc_correct <- function(voc_times_self, voc_times_partner, baseline_T = 1.0) {
  
  prc_data <- tibble(
    stimulus_phase = numeric(),
    phase_shift = numeric()  # This is the key difference!
  )
  
  for (i in 2:(length(voc_times_self)-1)) {
    
    cycle_start <- voc_times_self[i]
    expected_next <- cycle_start + baseline_T  # When WOULD you call without stimulus
    actual_next <- voc_times_self[i+1]         # When you ACTUALLY called
    
    # Find partner calls between your current call and your next call
    partner_calls <- voc_times_partner[
      voc_times_partner > cycle_start & 
      voc_times_partner < actual_next
    ]
    
    if (length(partner_calls) > 0) {
      stimulus_time <- partner_calls[1]
      
      # Stimulus phase: where in your cycle (0-360°)
      stimulus_phase <- ((stimulus_time - cycle_start) / baseline_T) * 360
      
      # Phase shift: difference between expected and actual
      # Negative = advanced (called earlier), Positive = delayed (called later)
      shift_time <- actual_next - expected_next
      phase_shift <- (shift_time / baseline_T) * 360
      
      # Keep stimulus phase in -180 to 360 range
      if (stimulus_phase > 360) stimulus_phase <- stimulus_phase - 360
      
      prc_data <- prc_data %>% add_row(
        stimulus_phase = stimulus_phase,
        phase_shift = phase_shift
      )
    }
  }
  
  prc_data
}

# Calculate corrected PRCs
prc_reset_corrected <- bind_rows(
  calculate_prc_correct(reset_sim$voc_times_1, reset_sim$voc_times_2, 1.0),
  calculate_prc_correct(reset_sim$voc_times_2, reset_sim$voc_times_1, 1.0)
) %>% mutate(Mechanism = "Reactive Reset")

prc_osc_corrected <- bind_rows(
  calculate_prc_correct(osc_sim$voc_times_1, osc_sim$voc_times_2, 1.0),
  calculate_prc_correct(osc_sim$voc_times_2, osc_sim$voc_times_1, 1.0)
) %>% mutate(Mechanism = "Entrainment")

prc_corrected <- bind_rows(prc_reset_corrected, prc_osc_corrected) %>%
  mutate(Mechanism = factor(Mechanism, levels = c("Entrainment", "Reactive Reset")))

# Plot: Phase SHIFT vs Stimulus Phase
panel_c <- prc_corrected %>%
  filter(stimulus_phase >= 0 & stimulus_phase <= 360) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = stimulus_phase, y = phase_shift)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Mechanism), size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = Mechanism, fill = Mechanism), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = F, alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Reactive Reset" = "#E69F00", 
                                "Entrainment" = "#56B4E9")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Reactive Reset" = "#E69F00", 
                               "Entrainment" = "#56B4E9")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 360, 90)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-180, 360, 45), limits = c(-200, 400)) +
  #facet_wrap(~Mechanism, ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "Stimulus Phase (°)", 
       y = "Phase Shift (°)\n(- = advance, + = delay)",
       title = "C) Phase Response Curves",
       #subtitle = "How partner's call timing shifts your response"
       ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    legend.position = c(0.9, 0.2),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "lines"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    strip.background = element_rect(color = "white", fill = "white", linewidth = 1.5),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 15, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0.5, r = 0.5, b = 0.5, l = 0.5, unit = "cm")
  )

panel_c

```
